== Introduction

This <<REF_IDX-DO_DO_ARCHITECTURE_MODEL,architecture models>> the engineering-model-go repository as a model-driven toolchain.
It captures authored functional intent, export surfaces, and verification-oriented traceability.
The <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> is intended to guide implementation work in this repository using stable IDs and support paths.

=== Scope and Assumptions

- <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_EM_FUNCTIONAL_GROUP,Functional Groups>> and <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_EM_FUNCTIONAL_UNIT,Functional Units>> are the stable authored design backbone.
- <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_EM_RUNTIME_ELEMENT,Runtime elements>> and <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_EM_CODE_ELEMENT,code elements>> are inferred from available IaC, deployment, and source artifacts.
- Inferred coverage is evidence-driven and may be partial when source metadata is missing.
- <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_EM_REQUIREMENT,Requirements>> and reference indexes are provided for traceability, not as primary narrative flow.

== How To Read This Document

This document is intentionally split into two layers:

1. Concept layer: functional and view-specific architecture narratives for human understanding.
2. Evidence layer: generated requirement traceability and inferred reference indexes.

Read in this order:

1. Architecture Intent View: stable authored architecture intent and ownership boundaries.
2. Communication / Deployment / Security Views: viewpoint-specific operational behavior.
3. Traceability View: requirement mapping, evidence coverage, and confidence.
4. Reference Appendix: supporting reference IDs and inferred-source links.

[[SEC_VIEW_VIEW-ARCHITECTURE-INTENT]]
== Architecture Intent View

Show the stable authored architecture intent: capability areas, unit ownership boundaries, and intentional responsibility split.

*Authored status:* in-review

*Authored scope and limitations:* Initial repository self-model with stable top-level domains; implementation details will be expanded iteratively.

=== What This View Answers


- What are the main capability areas?

- What are the stable units of responsibility and what does each unit own?

- How are responsibilities intentionally split?

===== Code health analysis (FU-CODE-HEALTH)





Analyses source functions for maintainability smells, scores files with our own explainable <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>>, rolls the scores up to <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_FUNCTIONAL_UNIT,functional units>>, <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirements>> and the project, and checks new or worsened findings against a base revision.

[discrete]
====== Owned Responsibility

functional responsibility for <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_FU_CODE_HEALTH,code health>> <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_ANALYSIS,analysis>>; includes decision and orchestration <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_FLOW,flow>> to <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_FU_CODEMAP_INFERENCE,Codemap Inference>> and decision and orchestration <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_FLOW,flow>> to <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_FU_MODEL_LOADER,Model Loader>>

[discrete]
====== Key Collaborators

<<REF_IDX-CATALOG_FU_CODEMAP_INFERENCE,Codemap Inference>>, <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_FU_MODEL_LOADER,Model Loader>>, <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_FU_VALIDATION_ENGINE,Validation Engine>>

===== Allocation Trace (FU-ALLOCATION-TRACE)





Traces <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirements>> across composed systems without modifying subsystem models - each child <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> up to the contract items it realizes, each system <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> down through its <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> links (pinned, fingerprinted and reviewed) to the child items and their realizing <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirements>> - and rolls a system <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> up from its reviewed, unchanged links; materializes the deprecated allocations for one release.

[discrete]
====== Owned Responsibility

functional responsibility for <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_FU_ALLOCATION_TRACE,allocation trace>>

[discrete]
====== Key Collaborators

none

==== Crafted repository artifacts mislead or stall the code scan (TS-ARTIFACT-PARSE-ABUSE)

A Markdown or container file in a scanned repository claims implementation through markers inside code blocks, hides markers after an over-long line, or is a symlink, FIFO or very large file that the scan follows or reads without bound.

|Flows |none
|Likelihood |medium
|Impact |medium
|Severity |medium
|Risk |none

|Mitigations |none
|Verifications |VER-ARTIFACT-SCAN-BOUNDS
|Operational Notes |Track closure through mitigation and verification linkage.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_003]]
==== REQ-EMG-003

While <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_STATE_MODEL_VALID,model is valid>>, when <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_GENERATION_RUN_REQUESTED,generation run is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall produce AsciiDoc architecture publication output without whitespace-only lines.


NOTE: Human-readable architecture output remains required and shall be clean for version <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_CONTROL,control>> and downstream processing.



===== Requirement-to-Unit-to-Evidence Coverage

What this diagram shows: this requirement-to-unit mapping extended with inferred runtime/code plus verification evidence attached to each requirement and unit.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_009]]
==== REQ-EMG-009

While <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_MODE_CI_VALIDATION,ci validation mode is active>>, when <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_GENERATION_RUN_REQUESTED,generation run is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall execute <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_VALIDATION,validation>> plus tests before <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_ARTIFACT_GENERATED,artifact generated event is raised>>.


NOTE: CI installs only the runtimes required by <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_VALIDATION,validation>>, uses mutually compatible exact <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_VALIDATOR,validator>> versions and supported command-line semantics for those versions, and configures dependency caches only when their native project metadata exists, so setup and <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_VALIDATION,validation>> do not fail before the <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_VALIDATION,validation>> gauntlet completes.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_010]]
==== REQ-EMG-010

Where <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_COND_REQUIREMENT_TRACE_COMPLETE,requirement trace is complete>>, when <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_MODEL_UPDATED,model updated event is received>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall infer traceability coverage from <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_TRACE_MARKER,trace markers>>.


NOTE: Links runtime, code, and test markers to modeled <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> coverage. Python and JavaScript declarations and lexical Verilog modules support explicit source links. Python decorators preserve definition coordinates; strings cannot create trace or ownership markers, and syntax errors are diagnosed; Verilog extraction does not elaborate HDL or expand macros. Individual source files and overlapping source directories preserve distinct file identities without double counting. Code and metadata scanning excludes dependency caches (node_modules, vendor) and dot-directories (.git, .engmod, tool caches) so coverage reflects only committed first-party source and stays reproducible.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_012]]
==== REQ-EMG-012

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_GENERATION_RUN_REQUESTED,generation run is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall generate artifacts deterministically so that regeneration is reproducible.


NOTE: <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_GENERATION,Generation>> uses stable ordering and controlled metadata so maintained artifacts are bit-for-bit reproducible. The <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_VALIDATION,validation>> gauntlet regenerates every maintained example and applies authoritative parsers or schemas where available plus semantic and idiomatic checks for each published format.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_013]]
==== REQ-EMG-013

Where <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_FEAT_TRACEABILITY_EXPORT,traceability export is enabled>>, when <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_GENERATION_RUN_REQUESTED,generation run is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall export an OSCAL aggregate profile plus SSP plus assessment plan plus assessment results plus POA&M artifacts when the corresponding <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_COMPLIANCE,compliance>> and remediation content is applicable.


NOTE: OSCAL documents use version 1.1.2 structures, deterministic metadata, resolvable sibling import links, aggregate every implemented <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_COMPLIANCE,compliance>> framework, and omit inapplicable documents rather than emitting schema-invalid empty artifacts.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_016]]
==== REQ-EMG-016

Where <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_FEAT_SYSTEM_COMPOSITION,system composition is enabled>>, when <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_GENERATION_RUN_REQUESTED,generation run is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall resolve the subsystem references declared by the parent system from local subdirectory paths.


NOTE: Recursive system-of-systems <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_COMPOSITION,composition>>; local subdirectory references and manifest dependencies; the clone of external git repositories into the .engmod cache (ADR-EMG-008) was retired with <<REF_IDX-REQ_REQ_EMG_027,REQ-EMG-027>>.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_020]]
==== REQ-EMG-020

Where <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_FEAT_SYSTEM_COMPOSITION,system composition is enabled>>, when <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_GENERATION_RUN_REQUESTED,generation run is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall materialize parent-to-subsystem <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_FU_ALLOCATION_TRACE,allocation trace>>ability in the composed output without modifying any subsystem <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>>.

Where <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_FEAT_SYSTEM_COMPOSITION,system composition is enabled>>, when <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_GENERATION_RUN_REQUESTED,generation run is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall report each subsystem required <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_INTERFACE,interface>> that the parent system does not satisfy.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_022]]
==== REQ-EMG-022

Where <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_FEAT_SYSTEM_COMPOSITION,system composition is enabled>>, when <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_GENERATION_RUN_REQUESTED,generation run is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall reject an <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_ALLOCATION,allocation>> that targets a subsystem identifier not published in the subsystem contract.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_023]]
==== REQ-EMG-023

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_GENERATION_RUN_REQUESTED,generation run is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall flag any <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> that links to another <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> in the same document.


NOTE: <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,Requirements>> carry no tiers. A <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> is either delegated to a subsystem through a downward <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_COMPOSITION,composition>> <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_ALLOCATION,allocation>> or implemented here, and the delegation link alone tells the two apart. Linking <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirements>> to one another inside a document recreates tier coupling and is confusing across system boundaries, so it is flagged.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_024]]
==== REQ-EMG-024

Where <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_FEAT_HARDWARE_INTERFACES,hardware interfaces are authored>>, when <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_GENERATION_RUN_REQUESTED,generation run is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall render the hardware to software <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_INTERFACE,interface>> <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_ALLOCATION,allocation>> <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_VIEW,view>>.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_026]]
==== REQ-EMG-026

Where <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_FEAT_SYSTEM_COMPOSITION,system composition is enabled>>, when <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_GENERATION_RUN_REQUESTED,generation run is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall render in the <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_VIEW,view>> the delegation link from each delegated <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> to the specific subsystem <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> that satisfies it.


NOTE: A provided contract entry names (ref) the subsystem <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> that realizes it, so a parent delegation traces to exactly the <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> that satisfies it. An allocated capability with no such ref is flagged as untraceable, and a ref to a <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> the subsystem does not define is rejected.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_027]]
==== REQ-EMG-027

Where <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_FEAT_SYSTEM_COMPOSITION,system composition is enabled>>, when <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_GENERATION_RUN_REQUESTED,generation run is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall resolve an external git subsystem reference by cloning the repository into the workspace .engmod cache.


NOTE: Retired: the engine no longer clones external git repositories. A schema version 2 subsystem resolves through a manifest dependency (local path, <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_WORKSPACE_REPLACEMENT,workspace replacement>> or exact CUE module version, <<REF_IDX-REQ_REQ_EMG_047,REQ-EMG-047>>, <<REF_IDX-REQ_REQ_EMG_048,REQ-EMG-048>>), and <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_COMPOSITION,composition>>.clone_failed no longer exists. Former behavior: a subsystem may reference an external repository with git (and an optional rev and path). The <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> is cloned once into .engmod/subsystems/<id> — a gitignored, temporary cache reused while it points at the same repository — and resolved like a local subsystem, giving a full cross-repository composed <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_VIEW,view>>. References stay downward-only.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_028]]
==== REQ-EMG-028

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_GENERATION_RUN_REQUESTED,generation run is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall reject a code trace link that resolves to no <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> or <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> element.


NOTE: Code markers (TRLC-LINKS to a <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>>, ENGMODEL-LINKS to a <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> element) are existence-checked against the <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>>, not only shape-checked, so a link to a deleted or mistyped id is a dangling link and fails the build. A trace link is only checked for the <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> that owns its code (see <<REF_IDX-REQ_REQ_EMG_030,REQ-EMG-030>> scoping).

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_030]]
==== REQ-EMG-030

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_GENERATION_RUN_REQUESTED,generation run is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall export a machine-readable traceability matrix that links each <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> to its implementing code and verification and delegated subsystem <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>>.


NOTE: One consolidated matrix (JSON) replaces having to read it out of prose and diagrams. Test-only source links count as verification, not production implementation. Code is attributed to the <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> whose engmod.yml is its nearest enclosing root, so a parent <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> never validates or counts a child <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>>'s trace links (monorepo scoping).

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_031]]
==== REQ-EMG-031

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_REQUIREMENTS_DELTA_RECEIVED,requirements delta is received>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall strictly validate <<REF_IDX-DO_DO_REQUIREMENTS_DELTA,requirements delta>> schema plus stable identifier operation uniqueness.


NOTE: Version 1 supports add, whole-entity update, and remove operations. Unknown fields, empty operations, duplicate operations, adds of existing IDs, and updates or removals of missing IDs are rejected.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_035]]
==== REQ-EMG-035

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_MODEL_UPDATED,model updated event is received>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall normalize <<REF_IDX-DO_DO_ARCHITECTURE_MODEL,architecture model>> plus <<REF_IDX-DO_DO_REQUIREMENTS_DOCUMENT,requirements document>> into <<REF_IDX-DO_DO_CANONICAL_SEMANTIC_MODEL,canonical semantic model>>.


NOTE: The <<REF_IDX-DO_DO_CANONICAL_SEMANTIC_MODEL,canonical semantic model>> is <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYSML,SysML>> v2 and <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_KERML,KerML>> aligned. Existing Engineering <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,Model>> concepts map into that <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> once; the authored YAML is the single input and no legacy adapter exists (ADR-EMG-061); it must not create a parallel set of parts, interfaces, flows, <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirements>>, allocations, or views.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_036]]
==== REQ-EMG-036

Where <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_FEAT_SYSML_EXPORT,sysml export is enabled>>, when <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_GENERATION_RUN_REQUESTED,generation run is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall generate <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_DATA_SYSML_V2_MODEL,sysml v2 model artifact>> from <<REF_IDX-DO_DO_CANONICAL_SEMANTIC_MODEL,canonical semantic model>>.


NOTE: The exporter preserves stable identifiers and maps standard concepts to native <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYSML,SysML>> v2 or <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_KERML,KerML>> semantics. Engineering-specific concepts may use explicit typed <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYSML,SysML>> metadata definitions, but canonical data without a native target representation must be omitted rather than encoded in descriptions, opaque payloads, generic property bags, or sidecar files.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_037]]
==== REQ-EMG-037

While <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_MODE_CI_VALIDATION,ci validation mode is active>>, when <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_GENERATION_RUN_REQUESTED,generation run is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall validate <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_DATA_SYSML_V2_MODEL,sysml v2 model artifact>> before <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_ARTIFACT_GENERATED,artifact generated event is raised>>.


NOTE: <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_VALIDATION,Validation>> must report unsupported or lossy mappings and progress toward abstract-syntax, textual-syntax, semantic, and model-interchange conformance. A syntactically <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_VALID,valid>> subset export must not be described as a complete <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYSML,SysML>> v2 semantic superset.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_038]]
==== REQ-EMG-038

Where <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_FEAT_SYSML_EXPORT,sysml export is enabled>>, when <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_GENERATION_RUN_REQUESTED,generation run is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall validate <<REF_IDX-DO_DO_CANONICAL_SEMANTIC_MODEL,canonical semantic model>> against <<REF_IDX-DO_DO_SYSML_V2_METAMODEL,sysml v2 metamodel>>.


NOTE: The pinned formal <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYSML,SysML>> 2.0 and <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_KERML,KerML>> 1.0 metamodel is the source of truth for supported classes, properties, relationships, ownership, and multiplicities. Generated CUE constraints and semantic registries must not be maintained as independent handwritten copies.

While <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_MODE_CI_VALIDATION,ci validation mode is active>>, when <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_GENERATION_RUN_REQUESTED,generation run is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall reject unsupported naf version plus unknown viewpoint code plus dangling profile reference before <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_ARTIFACT_GENERATED,artifact generated event is raised>>.


NOTE: <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_VALIDATION,Validation>> covers stakeholder <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_ACTOR,actor>> bindings, concern ownership, architecture-product concern references, and Engmod <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_VIEW,view>> references.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_044]]
==== REQ-EMG-044

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_MODEL_UPDATED,model updated event is received>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall load schema version 2 engmod manifest plus <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_CATALOG,catalog>> plus <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirements>> plus architecture plus behavior plus <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_ACT_COMPLIANCE_ENGINEER,assurance>> plus <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_COMPLIANCE,compliance>> plus views plus <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_DECISIONS_DOCUMENT,decisions documents>> into one <<REF_IDX-DO_DO_CANONICAL_SEMANTIC_MODEL,canonical semantic model>>.


NOTE: engmod.yml is the only <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> entry point and every document path is explicit. YAML is the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_AUTHORING,authoring>> format and CUE is the schema authority. <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,Requirements>> may carry format-neutral qualification metadata such as title, category, rationale, source references, verification methods and criteria, priority, criticality, status, derived disposition, and tags. Views own design narratives plus generic document definitions, document-control metadata, content selections, authored sections, and external references; architecture does not contain behavior, <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_ACT_COMPLIANCE_ENGINEER,assurance>>, <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_COMPLIANCE,compliance>>, dependency source, NAF, or projection-specific declarations.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_045]]
==== REQ-EMG-045

While <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_FEAT_MCP_SERVER,mcp server is enabled>>, when <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_MCP_TOOL_CALL_RECEIVED,mcp tool call is received>> and <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_COND_CATALOG_REFERENCES_RESOLVE,catalog references resolve successfully>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall return schema version 2 <<REF_IDX-DO_DO_MODEL_AUTHORING_CONTRACT,model authoring contract>>.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_046]]
==== REQ-EMG-046

While <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_MODE_CI_VALIDATION,ci validation mode is active>>, when <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_GENERATION_RUN_REQUESTED,generation run is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall reject <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> input that violates the schema version 2 manifest or any referenced domain document contract before <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_ARTIFACT_GENERATED,artifact generated event is raised>>.


NOTE: Missing documents, unsupported versions, unknown fields, duplicate concepts, <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_INVALID,invalid>> document-control values, incomplete derived <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> rationale, unresolved document content selections, unresolved local or qualified references, dependency publication violations, and cross-domain ownership violations are blocking.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_047]]
==== REQ-EMG-047

Where <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_FEAT_SYSTEM_COMPOSITION,system composition is enabled>>, when <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_GENERATION_RUN_REQUESTED,generation run is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall resolve each exact CUE module version from the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_OCI_REGISTRY,OCI registry>> configured by CUE_REGISTRY.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_048]]
==== REQ-EMG-048

Where <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_FEAT_MODEL_WORKSPACE_REPLACEMENT,a model workspace replacement is declared>>, when <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_GENERATION_RUN_REQUESTED,generation run is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall resolve the matching manifest dependency from the replacement repository without changing module identity or selected publications.


NOTE: engmod.work.yml maps module paths to local repositories for offline multi-repository development. A generated engmod.lock.yml records exact module versions and OCI digests but is not an authored semantic document.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_049]]
==== REQ-EMG-049

While <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_MODE_CI_VALIDATION,ci validation mode is active>>, when <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_GENERATION_RUN_REQUESTED,generation run is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall reject <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_INVALID,invalid>> manifest dependency plus publication plus <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_WORKSPACE_REPLACEMENT,workspace replacement>> plus qualified reference declarations.


NOTE: Every dependency requires one alias, one major-qualified module path, one exact version, and at least one exported publication. Aliases are unique, module identities match cue.mod/module.cue, workspace paths remain contained, imported references use alias double-colon stable-id syntax, and transitive entities are unavailable unless re-exported. A resolved dependency (registry module or <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_WORKSPACE_REPLACEMENT,workspace replacement>>) is confined to its module root: before any of its documents is read, every document reference, inferenceHints runtimeSources entry and inferenceHints exclude glob, engmod.yml and cue.mod/module.cue that is absolute or resolves after symlinks outside the module is rejected as <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_COMPOSITION,composition>>.dependency_path_escape naming the dependency alias and field, and no content of the target is read; the root <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>>'s own paths are not confined this way. A fetched module zip is checked before extraction (modzip rejects .. and absolute entries, the registry client verifies the blob digest) and an entry that is not a regular file or directory, such as a symlink, fails the fetch.

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_EXAMPLE_VALIDATION_REQUESTED,example validation is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall validate a schema version 2 company portfolio composed from multiple product systems that reuse published hardware plus software plus security plus <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_COMPLIANCE,compliance>> facets across repository boundaries.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_051]]
==== REQ-EMG-051

Where <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_FEAT_SYSTEM_COMPOSITION,system composition is enabled>>, when <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_GENERATION_RUN_REQUESTED,generation run is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall import only explicitly selected dependency publications with qualified identity plus source provenance.


NOTE: Each dependency publication exposes typed architecture, behavior, <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_ACT_COMPLIANCE_ENGINEER,assurance>>, <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_COMPLIANCE,compliance>>, <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>>, and <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_VIEW,view>> references. Imported entities retain module path, exact version, digest, source <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>>, and publication identity; unexported dependency entities remain inaccessible.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_052]]
==== REQ-EMG-052

Where <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_FEAT_SIX_VIEW_OUTPUT,six-view example output is enabled>>, when <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_GENERATION_RUN_REQUESTED,generation run is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall generate deterministic use-case plus logical plus process plus physical plus implementation plus deployment <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_VIEW,view>> artifacts and native <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYSML,SysML>> from one schema version 2 YAML bundle.


NOTE: The acceptance example preserves viewpoint separation, hierarchical capabilities, ordered typed interactions, nested hardware and software structures, ports, connections, engineering values, and software-to-hardware allocations. Mermaid sources and SVG renderings are generated without depending on authored <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYSML,SysML>> source files.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_053]]
==== REQ-EMG-053

Where <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_FEAT_DO178C_DAL_C_READINESS,do-178c dal c readiness output is enabled>>, when <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_MODEL_UPDATED,model updated event is received>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall load a strict aviation <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_ACT_COMPLIANCE_ENGINEER,assurance>> profile plus lifecycle data plus verification <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_EVIDENCE,evidence>> plus configuration baselines plus tool assessments plus structural coverage summaries.


NOTE: The <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> references DO-178C or ED-12C and customer-controlled licensed objective identifiers without reproducing normative objective text. It distinguishes declared, planned, executed, reviewed, accepted, not-applicable, and authority-accepted <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_EVIDENCE,evidence>> <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_STATE,states>>.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_055]]
==== REQ-EMG-055

Where <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_FEAT_DO178C_DAL_C_READINESS,do-178c dal c readiness output is enabled>>, when <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_GENERATION_RUN_REQUESTED,generation run is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall generate deterministic draft lifecycle data index plus objective <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_EVIDENCE,evidence>> matrix plus <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirements>> trace matrix plus verification summary plus structural coverage summary plus tool assessment register plus configuration index plus open gap report plus software accomplishment summary.


NOTE: Every output is visibly marked as draft evidence-readiness material, identifies its source baseline and unresolved gaps, and <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_STATE,states>> that responsible human review plus configuration <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_CONTROL,control>> plus certification authority acceptance remain required.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_057]]
==== REQ-EMG-057

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_MODEL_UPDATED,model updated event is received>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall derive the default code scan root from the enclosing module boundary.


NOTE: Without codeSources or an explicit code root, the scan root is the git working tree root, unless another engmod.yml exists between the manifest directory and that root, in which case it is the manifest directory. Directories holding another engmod.yml belong to that module and are skipped. Files ignored by git and paths matching inferenceHints.exclude glob patterns (relative to the module root, with dir/** for whole subtrees) are skipped. Explicit codeSources and code roots still override the default root.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_058]]
==== REQ-EMG-058

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_MODEL_UPDATED,model updated event is received>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall assign path-derived CODE identifiers to every in-scope file with its declarations.


NOTE: A file identifier is CODE- followed by its module-root-relative path, upper-cased with runs of non-alphanumeric characters folded to one hyphen (app/internal/capture.go becomes CODE-APP-INTERNAL-CAPTURE-GO). A declaration identifier appends two hyphens and the folded declaration name, so same-named declarations in different files stay distinct. Explicit TRACE-ID markers keep their authored value. Identifiers do not carry commit or blob versions because the <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> and the code are versioned together.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_059]]
==== REQ-EMG-059

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_MODEL_UPDATED,model updated event is received>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall resolve authored references to CODE identifiers against the in-scope module files.


NOTE: An unknown CODE identifier is a broken reference, an identifier produced by more than one file or declaration is rejected as ambiguous, and inferred RT- and AUTO- identifiers remain unreferenceable. The code index is built only when the <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> references a CODE identifier, so models without such references pay no scanning cost.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_060]]
==== REQ-EMG-060

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_MODEL_UPDATED,model updated event is received>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall reject <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REFERENCED_ELEMENT,referenced elements>> whose uri addresses a local path.


NOTE: <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REFERENCED_ELEMENT,Referenced elements>> describe artifacts outside the repository. A uri without a scheme or with the file scheme is rejected with a hint to reference the CODE identifier instead. A <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REFERENCED_ELEMENT,referenced element>> with a uri must declare a version unless the uri itself is immutable (a doi, or a uri carrying a full 40-hex commit id). <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REFERENCED_ELEMENT,Referenced elements>> without a uri remain <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_VALID,valid>> for offline documents identified by number and edition.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_062]]
==== REQ-EMG-062

Where <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_FEAT_GEMARA_EXPORT,gemara export is enabled>>, when <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_GENERATION_RUN_REQUESTED,generation run is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall derive each gemara enforcement disposition plus policy <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_RISK,risk>> treatment from the <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> status.


NOTE: Only a completed <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_POAM_ITEM,POA&M item>> is Enforced and only an accepted one Tolerated; planned, in-progress, deferred and unset items are Undetermined, and so is the log aggregate while any item is unresolved. The policy lists a <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_RISK,risk>> as mitigated only when its status is closed and as accepted only when its status is accepted or its response is accept; open and mitigating risks are left out with a gemara.policy_risks_untreated warning. The generator author is typed Software unless overridden. gemara.validate reports claims the <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> does not support as modelConsistencyErrors.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_063]]
==== REQ-EMG-063

Where <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_FEAT_SYSTEM_COMPOSITION,system composition is enabled>>, when <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_GENERATION_RUN_REQUESTED,generation run is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall select the <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> workspace from the ENGMOD_WORK setting.


NOTE: ENGMOD_WORK=off ignores every engmod.work.yml (CI and the pre-push gate); ENGMOD_WORK=<path> uses that file only and skips the parent search; unset searches parent directories as before. A path that does not exist is an error. CLI tools and the <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MCP_SERVER,MCP server>> accept --workspace=off|<path> with the same meaning.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_064]]
==== REQ-EMG-064

Where <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_FEAT_SYSTEM_COMPOSITION,system composition is enabled>>, when <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_GENERATION_RUN_REQUESTED,generation run is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall write or check the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_COMPOSITION,composition>> lock according to the lock mode.


NOTE: While <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_WORKSPACE_REPLACEMENT,workspace replacements>> are active the committed engmod.lock.yml is never modified and the resolved lock goes to engmod.lock.local.yml. With ENGMOD_LOCK=check (or --lock=check) the resolved lock is compared with engmod.lock.yml and <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_COMPOSITION,composition>>.lock_missing, <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_COMPOSITION,composition>>.lock_invalid or <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_COMPOSITION,composition>>.lock_mismatch (missing, extra or version-changed dependency, changed content digest after a moved tag) is reported and nothing is written. Exception: while <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_WORKSPACE_REPLACEMENT,workspace replacements>> are active the committed lock is not compared (it pins published content, the replacements are local) and the warning <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_COMPOSITION,composition>>.lock_check_skipped says that it is checked only with ENGMOD_WORK=off. Otherwise engmod.lock.yml is written as before. A cached registry module is reused offline, except that ENGMOD_MODULE_CACHE=refresh and lock regeneration (write mode with the workspace off) re-fetch every dependency, ENGMOD_MODULE_CACHE=reuse (ResolutionOptions.ModuleCache) reuses the cache offline in every lock mode, and otherwise lock check mode compares each cached module's recorded manifest digest with the registry (one lookup per dependency, cache reused when offline) and re-fetches a moved tag, so a warm cache never masks it. Diagnostics located in a fetched dependency name it as module@version:path instead of the cache directory.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_065]]
==== REQ-EMG-065

Where <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_FEAT_SYSTEM_COMPOSITION,system composition is enabled>>, when <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_GENERATION_RUN_REQUESTED,generation run is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall validate each qualified reference against the published entities of the selected dependencies.


NOTE: Covers relationships, flows and <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_FLOW_STEP,flow steps>>, appliesTo, <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_INTERFACE,interface>> and data references, ownership (<<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_FUNCTIONAL_UNIT,functional unit>> group, <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_INTERFACE,interface>> owner, <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_TRUST_BOUNDARY,trust boundary>> parent, <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_RISK,risk>>, threat and verification owners), <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_VIEW,view>> roots and code ENGMODEL-LINKS. <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,Requirements>> stay local, so trace counts do not include imported <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirements>>. A qualified reference to an entity the dependency does not publish is reported once as <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_COMPOSITION,composition>>.unpublished_reference with its field path, not as a generic broken reference. Only reference-typed fields are checked; prose (descriptions, notes, rationale, <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_FLOW_STEP,flow step>> actions) and file or URL fields (schemaRef, catalogRef, href) may contain :: freely.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_066]]
==== REQ-EMG-066

Where <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_FEAT_SYSTEM_COMPOSITION,system composition is enabled>>, when <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_GENERATION_RUN_REQUESTED,generation run is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall return the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_COMPOSITION,composition>> diagnostics with the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_GENERATION,generation>> result.


NOTE: GenerateAsciiDoc and the trace matrix return every <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_COMPOSITION,composition>> diagnostic, so callers need not compose again; <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_COMPOSITION,composition>> runs once per call and its result is reused. An unsatisfied required <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_INTERFACE,interface>> is an error for a <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> of kind system that has no parent and a warning otherwise; an <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_ALLOCATION,allocation>> whose target is not a contract provides entry is a warning.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_067]]
==== REQ-EMG-067

Where <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_FEAT_SYSTEM_COMPOSITION,system composition is enabled>>, when <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_GENERATION_RUN_REQUESTED,generation run is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall show the trace status of each delegated <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> in its target repository.


NOTE: For a delegated row the matrix computes the target <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>>'s own trace status (implemented, test linked, orphan) from the resolved dependency at its pinned or replaced version and reports it as delegatedStatus. The dependency's code scope is its own module directory (the workspace checkout or the module cache entry) minus its inferenceHints exclude globs, never the consumer repository around it; a dependency without code there shows not-available.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_068]]
==== REQ-EMG-068

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_WORKSPACE_SYNC_REQUESTED,workspace sync is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall write a <<REF_IDX-DEP_DEP_LOCAL_WORKSPACE,local workspace>> that replaces only changed or pinned checkouts.


NOTE: engws scans direct child directories with engmod.yml. A checkout is changed when its git tree is dirty, HEAD is not at tag v<module.version>, or that version is not in the registry configured by CUE_REGISTRY; .engws.yml pins force local. The root search stops below $HOME (never $HOME or an ancestor) and refuses a world-writable root unless --root names it; every command prints the root first. sync skips with a warning a checkout whose module.path is not a <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_VALID,valid>> major-qualified CUE module path or whose directory name is outside [A-Za-z0-9._-]. sync writes engmod.work.yml with the local checkouts and a go.work with every checkout that has go.mod (a non-local checkout is at its published tag, so go test and go run work in every checkout; go.work is removed when none has go.mod), and writes nothing inside any checkout. status and skew report SKEW when a local checkout's version differs from a version another checkout pins, or when a consumer's go.mod requires a checkout's Go module at another version than the checkout's version tag, and exit 1. check runs the <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> check in every local checkout affected by the change (reverse dependencies inside the workspace) and the top system with summary output; a repository's own .github/engmod-check is trusted code (stated in the help and the check output; --in-process is the choice for untrusted checkouts) and runs with an allowlisted environment (PATH, HOME, Go, CUE, proxy, certificate, XDG, DOCKER_CONFIG, CI and ENGMOD_* variables; no API keys or other credentials) and GOWORK set to its .github/engmod-check/go.work when present and off otherwise, never the root go.work; the in-process check relies on the library's qualified-reference <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_VALIDATION,validation>>; --refresh re-fetches dependencies; --all does not warn that engmod.work.yml lacks the unchanged checkouts. bump writes inside the consumer checkout: it updates a dependency version in engmod.yml, the matching go.mod require and go.sum (go get with GOWORK=off, after validating the Go module path) and the lock together, and restores all of them on any failure; pin and unpin write .engws.yml at the root.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_069]]
==== REQ-EMG-069

While <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_FEAT_MCP_SERVER,mcp server is enabled>>, when <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_MCP_TOOL_CALL_RECEIVED,mcp tool call is received>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall return <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_AUTHORING,authoring>> assistance for an edited <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> document.


NOTE: <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>>.complete returns local and imported qualified IDs (from dependencies pulled into the local cache), <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_CATALOG,catalog>> terms, allowed enum values and relationship type pairs that match a prefix and an optional field; <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>>.diagnose validates the <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> with one document's content supplied in the call and returns that document's diagnostics; dependencies resolve from the real project's workspace and module cache while the root system, its <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_COMPOSITION,composition>> and its alias::ID references are taken from the submitted content, and no lock is written. Both work offline from the local cache; no central service is involved. Every composing MCP read tool (<<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>>.complete, <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>>.diagnose, <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_COMPOSITION,composition>>.resolve, trace.matrix) resolves with lock check unless ENGMOD_LOCK is set and with module cache reuse unless ENGMOD_MODULE_CACHE or ENGMOD_LOCK is set, so it never writes engmod.lock.yml and makes no registry request when the cache is warm. <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_COMPOSITION,composition>>.resolve returns resolved directories relative to the workspace root, or as module@version for module cache entries, never as absolute paths.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_070]]
==== REQ-EMG-070

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_MODEL_UPDATED,model updated event is received>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall warn about every unconnected behavior element.


NOTE: Three warnings. behavior.event_unused names an authored behavior <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_EVENT,event>> that no machine transition names in on, no semantic transition lists as a trigger and no semantic relationship, <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_FLOW,flow>> or <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_FLOW_STEP,flow step>> references (catalog-only <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_EVENT,events>> are covered by <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_CATALOG,catalog>>.term_unreferenced). behavior.state_unreachable names a machine <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_STATE,state>> that no path of transitions leads to from the initial <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_STATE,state>> of the machine (v0.11.0, ADR-EMG-038; the first-declared-state heuristic and the transitions_to relationship are gone), and a machine without transitions reports its other <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_STATE,states>>. behavior.flow_step_no_onerror names a <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_FLOW_STEP,flow step>> with boundaryCrossing true and no onError step, at its onError path. Imported alias::ID entities are skipped.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_071]]
==== REQ-EMG-071

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_MODEL_UPDATED,model updated event is received>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall warn at each <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_CATALOG,catalog>> term whose name contains an EARS expression operator.


NOTE: <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_CATALOG,catalog>>.name_has_operator is reported once at the <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_CATALOG,catalog>> name or alias field (<<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_CATALOG,catalog>>.<group>[i].name or .aliases[j]) of an <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_ACTOR,actor>>, <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_EVENT,event>>, <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_STATE,state>>, feature, mode, condition or data term that contains a standalone and, or, not, a comma or a parenthesis. Such a term cannot match in a <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> clause, because the EARS expression parser splits it at the operator, and the <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> otherwise shows only unresolved-term diagnostics. System, <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_FUNCTIONAL_GROUP,functional group>> and unit names are matched whole by EARS and are not checked.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_072]]
==== REQ-EMG-072

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_MODEL_UPDATED,model updated event is received>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall report a multiple-response lint only for a <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> with more than one response action.


NOTE: lint.multiple_responses from ears-lint-go is dropped when the text has one shall and no semicolon, no and, or or comma comes before the first with, including or of in the response, that field list holds no then, and no list item after the first reads as a verb with its object (its second word is the, a, an, its, their, each, every or all). "publish one world <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_STATE,state>> message with UTC time, latitude, longitude and altitude" is not reported; "log the <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_EVENT,event>> and notify the operator", "log the <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_EVENT,event>> with the timestamp and notify the operator" and "stop all of the motors and close the valve" still are.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_073]]
==== REQ-EMG-073

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_GENERATION_RUN_REQUESTED,generation run is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall warn about each <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_CONTROL_VERIFICATION,control verification>> status that lags its existing tests.


NOTE: A <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_CONTROL_VERIFICATION,control verification>> may name its tests in verificationRefs: inferred CODE identifiers of test declarations (CODE-<PATH>--<NAME>) or <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> IDs whose linked test entry points verify it; any other entry is the error <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>>.invalid_control_verification_ref. verification.status_stale is a warning at the status of a <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_CONTROL_VERIFICATION,control verification>> whose status is unset or not-run while a referenced test declaration exists in the scanned code or a referenced <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> is test linked, and at the status of a <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_THREAT_MITIGATION,threat mitigation>> whose status is unset or planned while a <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_CONTROL_VERIFICATION,control verification>> it references has such tests. The status stays authored. The AsciiDoc <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_GENERATION,generation>> and the trace matrix both report it.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_080]]
==== REQ-EMG-080

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_WORKSPACE_STAGING_REQUESTED,workspace staging is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall publish every workspace checkout into the local staging area in dependency order.


NOTE: engws stage [--version-from manifest|tag] [--serve] [--addr] writes only under <root>/.engmod/staging, never inside a checkout. registry/<module path>/ holds each CUE module as an OCI image layout with the content cue mod publish would push (source kind git: the committed files from git ls-files with VCS metadata; kind self: the directory). goproxy/ is a GOPROXY file tree (<module>/@v/<version>.info, .mod, .zip and list) for each checkout with go.mod at its top, zipped from committed files. The version is module.version from engmod.yml; with --version-from tag HEAD must be at tag v<module.version>. A checkout cue mod publish would refuse (dirty tree, no source field, module path mismatch) is reported, and then nothing is staged. A consumer pinning a family module at another version than the staged one is warned about. CUE has no file registry, so --serve loads the layouts into an in-memory read-only <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_OCI_REGISTRY,OCI registry>> on a loopback address only and serves it in the foreground until interrupted. stage prints the gate environment: CUE_REGISTRY routes for the staged modules merged with the current CUE_REGISTRY (with --serve), GOPROXY=file://<staging>/goproxy,off, GONOPROXY=none, GONOSUMDB with the staged Go modules plus the current GONOSUMDB or GOPRIVATE, GOWORK=off and ENGMOD_WORK=off; no -mod flag.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_081]]
==== REQ-EMG-081

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_SPEC_DELTA_REQUESTED,spec delta is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall render OpenSpec spec delta text from the selected <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirements>>.


NOTE: <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_ENGMODEL,engmodel>>.RenderSpecDelta and RenderSpecDeltaFromModel, and the <<REF_IDX-IF_IF_CLI_ENGSPEC,engspec CLI>> (--model, --ids or --prefix, --capability, --modified, --out), render ## ADDED (or MODIFIED) <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,Requirements>> and per <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> a ### <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,Requirement>> heading (title, else ID; a repeated title names its ID), the line <ID>: <<<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> text> with whitespace collapsed and whole-word shall and must upper-cased, so it starts with the <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> text under the engineering-flow consistency normalization (lower case, collapsed whitespace, no backticks or trailing period), and one #### Scenario from verificationCriteria: GIVEN, WHEN and THEN bullets when the criteria are shaped [given …,] when …, then …; otherwise WHEN the <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> is verified and THEN the criteria. <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,Requirements>> without shall or must, or without verificationCriteria, are returned as warnings; an unknown ID is an error.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_082]]
==== REQ-EMG-082

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_MODEL_UPDATED,model updated event is received>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall report each <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_ACT_COMPLIANCE_ENGINEER,assurance>> record whose verification links disagree.


NOTE: threat.verification_missing is a warning at a <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_THREAT_SCENARIO,threat scenario>>'s verificationRefs when it omits a <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_CONTROL_VERIFICATION,control verification>> that one of its <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_THREAT_MITIGATION,threat mitigations>> (threatScenarioRef) lists in verificationRefs or that names the threat in threatScenarioRefs. mitigation.verification_control_mismatch is an error at a <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_THREAT_MITIGATION,threat mitigation>> verificationRefs entry naming a <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_CONTROL_VERIFICATION,control verification>> whose controlRef is another <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_CONTROL,control>> than the mitigation's controlRef. verification.unlinked is a warning at the verificationRefs of a <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_CONTROL_VERIFICATION,control verification>> with method test and status pass or partial that has no verificationRefs, so no test declaration or <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> evidences it; <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_ANALYSIS,analysis>>, inspection and other methods are evidenced by their <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_EVIDENCE,evidence>> entries and are not reported. Imported alias::ID records are skipped. The AsciiDoc <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_GENERATION,generation>>, the trace and <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>>.diagnose report them through <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_VALIDATION,validation>>.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_083]]
==== REQ-EMG-083

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_MODEL_UPDATED,model updated event is received>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall warn at each <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_CONTROL,control>> that the gemara evaluation log would mark for review.


NOTE: gemara.control_needs_review is a warning at a <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_CONTROL,control>> that the Gemara L5 evaluation log gives the result Needs Review: no <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_CONTROL_VERIFICATION,control verification>> names it in controlRef, or at least one of its <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_CONTROL_VERIFICATION,control verifications>> has a status that needs review (partial, planned, in-progress, review, needs-review) and none failed or has an unrecognized status, since Failed and Unknown outrank Needs Review in the log's aggregate. validate.ClassifyVerificationStatus and validate.ControlNeedsReview are the one status mapping the evaluation log and the warning share. When a <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_CONTROL,control>> without verification has a <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_THREAT_MITIGATION,threat mitigation>> that references another <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_CONTROL,control>>'s verification, the message names it ("<CV> verifies <other <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_CONTROL,control>>>"); for a <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_CONTROL,control>> whose verifications need review it names them with their status. <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_VALIDATION,Validation>> emits it, so the check path (<<REF_IDX-CATALOG_ENGDOC,engdoc>>, the trace, <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>>.diagnose) reports it without rendering Gemara.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_084]]
==== REQ-EMG-084

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_MODEL_UPDATED,model updated event is received>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall infer implementation coverage from <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_TRACE_MARKER,trace markers>> in comments of build and documentation artifacts.


NOTE: The code scanner reads TRLC-LINKS, ENGMODEL-LINKS and ENGMODEL-OWNER-UNIT in # comment lines of files named Dockerfile or Containerfile or ending in .Dockerfile or .Containerfile, and in HTML comments (<!-- TRLC-LINKS: REQ-… -->, also spanning lines) that start a line outside fenced code blocks of .md and .markdown files. The markers apply to the whole file: it becomes one symbol with its file CODE identifier (CODE-<PATH>) that implements the linked <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirements>>, never verifies them, also under tests/. Markers are optional: such a file without them yields no item and no code.missing_trlc_link. The module code scope applies, including git-ignored files and inferenceHints.exclude; an <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_INVALID,invalid>> <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> ID is code.invalid_trlc_link.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_085]]
==== REQ-EMG-085

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_MODEL_UPDATED,model updated event is received>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall report each accepted <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_ACT_COMPLIANCE_ENGINEER,assurance>> record that lacks an owner acceptance record.


NOTE: A <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_RISK,risk>> with status accepted or response accept, and a <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_THREAT_SCENARIO,threat scenario>> with status accepted, must carry acceptedBy with <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_ACTOR,actor>> (an existing ACT-* <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_ACTOR,actor>>), date (a YYYY-MM-DD calendar date, parsed, so 2026-13-45 is rejected) and statement (the owner's own words) or decisionRef (an existing decision with status accepted whose context quotes the owner); otherwise <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_RISK,risk>>.acceptance_unrecorded is an error at its acceptedBy field naming the missing parts. An acceptedBy <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_ACTOR,actor>>, date or decisionRef that does not resolve, or a decisionRef to a decision that is not accepted, is <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>>.invalid_acceptance (error). <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_RISK,risk>>.acceptance_not_owner is a warning at the acceptedBy <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_ACTOR,actor>> of a <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_RISK,risk>> whose owner is set and differs from the <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_ACTOR,actor>>. <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_RISK,risk>>.accept_while_open is a warning at a <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_RISK,risk>> status when response is accept and status is open, since the Gemara policy would otherwise list it as accepted while it is open. The Gemara policy lists a <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_RISK,risk>> under risks.accepted only when its acceptance record is complete and resolves (validate.AcceptanceRefs, shared with <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_VALIDATION,validation>>) and its status is accepted, or its response is accept and its status is not open; gemara.validate (CheckGemaraModelConsistency) reports an accepted entry that does not meet this. Imported alias::ID records are skipped; the schema rejects :: in authored <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_RISK,risk>> and <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_THREAT_SCENARIO,threat scenario>> IDs, so a local ID cannot pose as imported. The record is an authored claim: these checks make it complete and consistent, and human review of the diff that adds it is the actual <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_CONTROL,control>> that the owner gave it.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_086]]
==== REQ-EMG-086

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_WORKSPACE_SYNC_REQUESTED,workspace sync is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall write a go workspace replace directive for each required version of a workspace go module.


NOTE: engws sync writes, next to the use entries of the family go.work, one line replace <module> <version> => ./<dir> for every Go module of a checkout listed in use and every distinct version at which any checkout's go.mod requires that module; a module no checkout requires gets no replace. go resolves the go.mod of a required version even when the module is in use, so an unpublished family module fails to build without it; an unversioned replace is rejected for a workspace module. The generated-file header and the hand-written file check are unchanged. A repository's .github/engmod-check uses its own go.work or GOWORK=off and is not affected.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_087]]
==== REQ-EMG-087

While <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_FEAT_MCP_SERVER,mcp server is enabled>>, when <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_MCP_TOOL_CALL_RECEIVED,mcp tool call is received>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall return the allowed fields of each entity kind with the <<REF_IDX-DO_DO_MODEL_AUTHORING_CONTRACT,model authoring contract>>.


NOTE: validate.AuthoringRules (<<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>>.authoringContract rules) adds fieldSets, the YAML field names each entity kind accepts (<<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_RISK,risk>>, <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_CONTROL,control>>, threatScenario, flowStep and the others), derived from the strict-decoding Go types, and publicationSections, the manifest publication sections (architecture, behavior, <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_ACT_COMPLIANCE_ENGINEER,assurance>>, <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_COMPLIANCE,compliance>>, <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirements>>, views; decisions cannot be published). fieldRules <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_STATE,state>> that boundaryCrossing true needs trustBoundaryRef (<<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>>.missing_flow_boundary_ref), what behavior.event_unused counts as a use (the on of machine transitions, semantic relationship sources, targets and triggers, <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_FLOW,flow>> and <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_FLOW_STEP,flow step>> sourceRef and destinationRef, <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_FLOW_STEP,flow step>> ref; not properties or prose), the lint.multiple_responses field-list exemption (one shall, the list opens with with, including or of, no list item after the first starts a verb with a determiner) and that in strict EARS mode the system term is a <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_CATALOG,catalog>> system, <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_FUNCTIONAL_GROUP,functional group>> or <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_FUNCTIONAL_UNIT,functional unit>> name or alias.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_088]]
==== REQ-EMG-088

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_MODEL_UPDATED,model updated event is received>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall report each <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> whose linked tests are all environment gated.


NOTE: A Go test entry point whose first statements include an if whose condition calls os.Getenv, os.LookupEnv or testing.Short and whose body calls t.Skip, t.Skipf or t.SkipNow is gated (the variable name, or testing.Short). A <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> linked from a test file only by gated tests carries that gate in the <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_VERIFICATION_CHECK,verification check>>; a trace row whose every verification is gated for it has gated true and its gates, and the summary counts it in gatedOnly and lists it in gatedOnlyRequirements. testLinked still counts it. The MCP trace.matrix summary returns gatedOnly and gatedOnlyRequirements and its rows gated.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_089]]
==== REQ-EMG-089

While <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_FEAT_MCP_SERVER,mcp server is enabled>>, when <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_MCP_TOOL_CALL_RECEIVED,mcp tool call is received>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall return <<REF_IDX-DO_DO_MCP_TOOL_RESULT,mcp tool result>> from the module <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> files on disk at call time.


NOTE: The server fingerprints this module's <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> files at load: the manifest, every document it names, the <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirements>> and design paths, and the lock and workspace files next to the manifest (engmod.lock.yml, engmod.lock.local.yml, engmod.work.yml). Before each tools/call it recomputes the fingerprint and reloads the <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> when it differs; a reload that fails is returned as the call error (-32001) instead of the previous <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>>, and the next call retries. Documents of dependencies resolved from sibling checkouts or the module cache are not fingerprinted: after editing a sibling checkout the client re-sends initialize. Only regular files up to 16 MiB are hashed; a larger file is compared by size and modification time and a non-regular file by its mode.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_090]]
==== REQ-EMG-090

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_MODEL_UPDATED,model updated event is received>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall report each <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> without an upward trace.


NOTE: No <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> can know it is top level, because any system may later be used by one above (decision D22, ADR-EMG-028), so every <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> traces through a capability. A <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> traces upward iff (a) it realizes a local capability or assumption of use (or is named by a deprecated capability ref), (b) it is the parent of a reqLinks entry whose child is a dependency capability (alias::CAP-*), or (c) it is derived: true with derivedRationale. Stakeholder sourceRefs do not count, and no <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> is exempt (inferenceHints.topLevel does not exist; the strict schema rejects it). Otherwise <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>>.no_parent is reported at the <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> with a message naming exactly these three options: an error with requirementLinks strict in every <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>>; a warning with guided (the default) only in a <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> that publishes a contract item or has reqLinks; nothing in a guided standalone <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>>. A realizes target that is a <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>>, an imported alias::ID, an <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_INTERFACE,interface>> entry or unknown is <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>>.realizes_unknown (error). requirementLinks other than strict or guided is <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>>.invalid_requirement_links (error). The rule needs only the child repository.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_091]]
==== REQ-EMG-091

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_MODEL_UPDATED,model updated event is received>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall load assumptions of use as contract items with their realizing <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirements>>.


NOTE: contract.assumptions entries have id (AOU-*), text and optional verificationCriteria. They are published in a publication architecture list like capabilities, imported as alias::AOU-* by a composing bundle, and count as contract items: a <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> may realize them and engws bump compares their meaning between versions. Contract items are contract.provides entries of kind capability and the assumptions; <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_INTERFACE,interface>> entries are not link targets.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_092]]
==== REQ-EMG-092

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_MODEL_UPDATED,model updated event is received>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall report each <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> that realizes a published contract item without being published itself.


NOTE: contract.realizer_unpublished is an error at a <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> that realizes (through realizes or a deprecated ref) a contract item that a publication exposes, when that publication does not list the <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> under <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirements>>. A using system compares the item with its realizers from the published content alone, so every realizer must be visible to it.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_093]]
==== REQ-EMG-093

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_MODEL_UPDATED,model updated event is received>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall warn at each published capability without a realizing <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>>.


NOTE: contract.unrealized (warning) names a published capability with no realizing <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>>. A contract.provides entry that carries ref is the error <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>>.provides_ref_removed (<<REF_IDX-REQ_REQ_EMG_184,REQ-EMG-184>>) and the ref counts as no realizer; the realizing <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> names the capability with realizes.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_094]]
==== REQ-EMG-094

Where <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_FEAT_SYSTEM_COMPOSITION,system composition is enabled>>, when <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_MODEL_UPDATED,model updated event is received>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall validate each <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> link against the manifest dependency pins.


NOTE: The optional document documents.reqLinks (<<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>>/req-links.yml) holds reqLinks entries {id, parent, child, <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_EVIDENCE,evidence>>, pinned {version}, status claimed|accepted, rationale, reviewedBy, reviewedOn}, strictly decoded and checked by the CUE schema (pinned.fingerprint is deprecated: still accepted for one release and ignored, <<REF_IDX-REQ_REQ_EMG_118,REQ-EMG-118>>). A parent that is no local <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>>, a link with neither parent nor <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_EVIDENCE,evidence>>, or <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_EVIDENCE,evidence>> that is no local ID is link.parent_unknown; a child that is not alias::ID of a declared dependency selected by a <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_COMPOSITION,composition>> subsystem is link.child_unpublished; pinned.version other than the dependency version is link.version_mismatch (errors; the link was reviewed at another version and needs review at this one, decision D23); status claimed is link.claimed_only (warning). A dependency version may be a Go-style pseudo-version.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_095]]
==== REQ-EMG-095

The <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall compare the meaning of each contract item with its realizing <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirements>> between two versions.


NOTE: reqlinks.ItemMeaning is compact JSON {"item":{id,kind,text,verificationCriteria},"realizers":[{id,text,verificationCriteria}...]} with realizers sorted by id, every string whitespace-collapsed and trimmed, case kept, no HTML escaping and no trailing newline; the text of a capability is its note. reqlinks.SameMeaning compares two versions and reqlinks.MeaningChanges names each difference by ID (item kind, item text, item verificationCriteria, <REQ> added, removed, text, verificationCriteria). A realizers status, notes, criticality, verification methods, title, rationale, appliesTo, priority and tags are not compared: they do not change what the item obliges, and a status change must not trigger a review (decision D23). No hash is computed or recorded. A using system compares the published items and realizers (reqlinks.PublishedItems), so a change to a <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> that realizes no linked item never changes one.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_096]]
==== REQ-EMG-096

Where <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_FEAT_SYSTEM_COMPOSITION,system composition is enabled>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall accept a dependency version that is a release tag or a pseudo-version carrying a commit.


NOTE: The CUE #ExactVersion and ParseExactModuleVersion accept a canonical semantic version, including Go-style pseudo-versions v1.2.4-0.20261102103400-abcdef123456. A release only uses tags; engws release-check rejects pseudo-versions (<<REF_IDX-REQ_REQ_EMG_103,REQ-EMG-103>>).

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_097]]
==== REQ-EMG-097

Where <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_FEAT_SYSTEM_COMPOSITION,system composition is enabled>>, when <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_GENERATION_RUN_REQUESTED,generation run is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall report each <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> link whose contract item does not exist at the pinned dependency version.


NOTE: <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_COMPOSITION,Composition>> evaluates each reqLinks entry against the resolved dependency without comparing content (reqlinks.EvaluateLinks, decision D23): unchanged (pin equal to the dependency pin, item published), version_mismatch (the pin differs; reported by <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_VALIDATION,validation>>, <<REF_IDX-REQ_REQ_EMG_094,REQ-EMG-094>>), broken (the item does not exist at the dependency pin, also behind a stale pin; link.broken error), child_unpublished (it exists but is not a published capability or assumption of use; link.child_unpublished error), unresolved, or local: a dependency resolved from a <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_WORKSPACE_REPLACEMENT,workspace replacement>> is a checkout, not a version, and raises no link finding at all (no link.broken, child_unpublished or aou_unverified), so editing a child in a workspace never churns the system. The diagnostics join the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_COMPOSITION,composition>> diagnostics, so <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_ENGDOC,engdoc>>, engmod-check and <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>>.diagnose report them, one line per link with its ID; they do not stop the lock from being written. link.suspect no longer exists.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_098]]
==== REQ-EMG-098

Where <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_FEAT_SYSTEM_COMPOSITION,system composition is enabled>>, when <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_GENERATION_RUN_REQUESTED,generation run is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall report each dependency assumption of use without an <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_EVIDENCE,evidence>> link and each system <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> satisfied by nothing.


NOTE: link.aou_unverified is reported for every published assumption of use of a composed dependency that no reqLinks entry with <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_EVIDENCE,evidence>> names as child. <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>>.unsatisfied is reported by the trace integrity check at a <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> of a <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> with <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_COMPOSITION,composition>> subsystems that no code or test of the <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> links, no reqLinks entry names as parent, no <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_ALLOCATION,allocation>> delegates and that is not derived. Both are errors with requirementLinks strict and warnings with guided where links apply (validate.RequirementLinkRules).

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_099]]
==== REQ-EMG-099

While <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_FEAT_MCP_SERVER,mcp server is enabled>>, when <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_MCP_TOOL_CALL_RECEIVED,mcp tool call is received>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall describe <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> links in the <<REF_IDX-DO_DO_MODEL_AUTHORING_CONTRACT,model authoring contract>>.


NOTE: The <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_AUTHORING,authoring>> contract field rules describe realizes, contract.assumptions, the reqLinks document and the requirementLinks strictness, and fieldSets list contractAssumption, reqLink and reqLinkPin; the reqLinks document is listed when the manifest names it. Each <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_COMPOSITION,composition>>.allocations entry is <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_COMPOSITION,composition>>.allocation_deprecated (warning) and still materializes as before for one release.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_100]]
==== REQ-EMG-100

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_DEPENDENCY_BUMP_REQUESTED,dependency bump is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall move the pin of each <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> link whose contract item means the same at the new version and keep the pin of every other link for review.


NOTE: engws bump <repo> <alias> <version> [--allow-review] [--show] updates the pin, go.mod and lock, then compares each reqLinks entry of the consumer on the bumped alias between its pinned version and the new version, both published and resolved with the workspace off (linkreview.ItemsAtVersion; module cache verified against the registry digest, else the registry), by meaning (reqlinks.SameMeaning, <<REF_IDX-REQ_REQ_EMG_095,REQ-EMG-095>>). Decision D23: the same meaning moves pinned.version to the new version (moved); a changed meaning (review, printed with the changes by ID), a pinned version that cannot be resolved (review, saying so) or an item gone at the new version (broken) keeps the old pin, so the <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> check reports link.version_mismatch (or link.broken) until engws review-links --accept. A link already at the new version is current. One line per link, IDs only; --show adds the item before and after. The bump is written either way; exit 1 when a link needs review, 0 with --allow-review (--allow-suspect is a deprecated alias); any failure restores engmod.yml, go.mod, go.sum, engmod.lock.yml and <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>>/req-links.yml. link.* diagnostics do not block lock regeneration.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_101]]
==== REQ-EMG-101

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_LINK_REVIEW_REQUESTED,link review is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall show the child item change of each <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> link that needs review.


NOTE: engws review-links [--repo DIR] [--json] [--show] lists every link that needs review (version_mismatch, broken or claimed; linkreview.NeedsReview), composed with the workspace off (the published dependencies; a workspace checkout has no version to review), one line per link: ID, child, <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_STATE,state>>, claimed, pinned and dependency version and what changed in meaning between the item at the pinned version (before) and at the dependency pin (after) by ID, or same meaning, or why it is unknown. --show adds the parent <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> text and the item with its realizing <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirements>> before and after, changed lines marked - and +; --json gives the full reviews. Cached modules are verified against the registrys manifest digest and refetched when it differs, so a version re-staged with other content (engws stage) is seen. Exit 0 when nothing needs review, 1 otherwise. --accept LNK-ID --by ACT-ID --rationale TEXT writes into the <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> link file, editing only the touched lines (yaml.v3 node positions, comments and order kept): pinned.version (the dependency pin), reviewedBy, reviewedOn (today), rationale and status accepted, and removes a deprecated pinned.fingerprint; it refuses an <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_ACTOR,actor>> the <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> does not define, an unknown link, a <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_BROKEN_LINK,broken link>> and one whose item is not resolved at the dependency pin with the workspace off (decision D9), writing nothing. After writing it evaluates the link again and exits 1 naming the finding when it still does not pass (for example link.parent_unknown). A file it rewrites keeps its permission bits.
