[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_173]]
==== REQ-EMG-173

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_MODEL_UPDATED,model updated event is received>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall report a machine without an invariant and an invariant without a current formal result.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_174]]
==== REQ-EMG-174

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_MODEL_UPDATED,model updated event is received>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall keep every <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> link marker stacked above one declaration.


NOTE: ADR-EMG-069. The scanner accumulated stacked trace link lines and overwrote stacked <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> link lines, so a second line hid the first and element to code coverage would have missed links. Both now accumulate, in the order written, without duplicates.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_175]]
==== REQ-EMG-175

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_MODEL_UPDATED,model updated event is received>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall report a <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_FUNCTIONAL_UNIT,functional unit>>, machine or software <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_INTERFACE,interface>> that no source code names.


NOTE: ADR-EMG-069. code.unit_unlinked, code.machine_unlinked and code.interface_unlinked, row DDWEE. An element counts as named when an owner marker, a <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> link marker or a trace part marker in scanned non-test source carries its identifier. <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_ACTOR,Actors>>, <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_ATTACK_VECTOR,attack vectors>>, <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_TRUST_BOUNDARY,trust boundaries>>, <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_THREAT_SCENARIO,threat scenarios>>, assumptions, out-of-scope entries, risks, <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_POAM_ITEM,POA&M items>>, <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET,deployment targets>>, decisions, <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_CATALOG,catalog>> terms, views and imported alias elements are never asked. A <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> without a code root is not asked.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_176]]
==== REQ-EMG-176

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_MODEL_UPDATED,model updated event is received>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall accept a recorded exemption for a <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> element that is deliberately not implemented in this repository.


NOTE: ADR-EMG-069. codeCoverage.exempt in engmod.yml is a list of an element identifier, a reason and an accepted decision, shaped like a health waiver. A missing or unaccepted decision is the untiered error code.exemption_unjustified, and an exemption that matches no unlinked element is code.exemption_unused (a warning, an error at operational).

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_177]]
==== REQ-EMG-177

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_MODEL_UPDATED,model updated event is received>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall accept a list of <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirements>> on every machine <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_STATE,state>>, transition and <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_EVENT,event>>.


NOTE: ADR-EMG-069. The optional <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirements>> field on a machine <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_STATE,state>>, a machine transition and an <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_EVENT,event>> names the <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirements>> the element exists for, like the <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirements>> field of an invariant. An unknown <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> identifier is the same dangling reference error an invariant gets, and an unknown key is still rejected.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_178]]
==== REQ-EMG-178

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_MODEL_UPDATED,model updated event is received>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall report a machine <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_STATE,state>>, transition or <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_EVENT,event>> that lists no <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>>.


NOTE: ADR-EMG-069. behavior.state_unlinked, behavior.transition_unlinked and behavior.event_unlinked, row DDWWE. Only a <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> that declares at least one machine is asked, only <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_EVENT,events>> that a machine transition uses are asked, and an imported alias machine is skipped. The element is linked only by its own <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirements>> list; an invariant of the machine does not link it. The remedy names the ef-behavior skill.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_179]]
==== REQ-EMG-179

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_MODEL_UPDATED,model updated event is received>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall report a <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_COMPOSITION,composition>> lock whose schema version is not the current one.


NOTE: ADR-EMG-072, removal plan phase 1. <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_COMPOSITION,composition>>.lock_schema_outdated is a core error: the lock file schema version is read and compared with the version the engine writes, and an older or missing version is an error whose remedy names engws bump and engws sync instead of a mode that still works. Before this the version was never checked.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_180]]
==== REQ-EMG-180

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_MODEL_UPDATED,model updated event is received>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall report a repository check template that cannot take the workspace root instead of checking the repository with the library.


NOTE: ADR-EMG-072, removal plan phase 1. engine.check_template_stale replaces the silent fallback of engws check to the in-process library: a repository whose .github/engmod-check lacks workspace root support is reported with the remedy to upgrade the check template with engflow upgrade, and it is not checked by another route. A repository with no .github/engmod-check at all is checked by the library only when the caller names the in-process option.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_181]]
==== REQ-EMG-181

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_MODEL_UPDATED,model updated event is received>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall report an engine pin of a repository that is older than the engine that checks it.


NOTE: ADR-EMG-072, removal plan phase 1. engine.pin_outdated compares the engineering-model-go version in the go.mod of the repository check template with the engine version of the running binary and reports an older pin with the remedy to bump the pin. An unparsable version or a local replacement is not compared.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_182]]
==== REQ-EMG-182

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_MODEL_UPDATED,model updated event is received>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall provide one name for every argument of every tool and command.


NOTE: ADR-EMG-073, removal plan phase 3. The aliases of the tool arguments (id for the typed identifier arguments, reqId, name, q, file, env, left, right, task, leftSchemaRef, rightSchemaRef, leftInterfaceId, rightInterfaceId, path for document), the duplicate tool entities.list, the deprecated flag --allow-suspect of engws and the flag --out of <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_ENGOSCAL,engoscal>> are removed. An old name is rejected by the strict argument check like any unknown argument. The <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> fields BaseCatalogRef and Compatibility, the trace summary counters Verified and LinksSuspect and the unused inert code source literals are removed.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_183]]
==== REQ-EMG-183

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_MODEL_UPDATED,model updated event is received>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall report a dependency without a declared tier as an error and report an incomplete aviation assessment and an unreferenced <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_CATALOG,catalog>> term by tier.


NOTE: ADR-EMG-074, removal plan phase 5. <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_COMPOSITION,composition>>.dependency_tier_unknown is a core error at every tier (a dependency that declares no life-cycle tier cannot be compared with this system). The aviation codes incomplete_credit_assessment and incomplete_safety_feedback are errors from mvp, like the other aviation floors. <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_CATALOG,catalog>>.term_unreferenced is a warning below product and an error from product, so a strict <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_CATALOG,catalog>> is not left with unused vocabulary at the tiers that require clean models.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_184]]
==== REQ-EMG-184

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_MODEL_UPDATED,model updated event is received>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall reject a deprecated pinned fingerprint and a deprecated provides reference with an error that names the remedy.


NOTE: ADR-EMG-075, removal plan phase 4. A <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> link that carries pinned.fingerprint is the error <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>>.pinned_fingerprint_removed and a contract provides entry that carries ref is the error <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>>.provides_ref_removed. Each is an untiered error whose message names the field to delete, instead of the warning pinned.fingerprint was or a bare strict-decoding error. The two requires ref lines of the Atlas examples are deleted because nothing reads them.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_185]]
==== REQ-EMG-185

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_REQUIREMENTS_DELTA_APPLY_REQUESTED,requirements delta apply is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall refuse to write when another apply holds the lock, when the candidate is <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_INVALID,invalid>> or when the <<REF_IDX-DO_DO_REQUIREMENTS_DOCUMENT,requirements document>> changed while the delta was planned.


NOTE: The apply takes an exclusive lock on the <<REF_IDX-DO_DO_REQUIREMENTS_DOCUMENT,requirements document>> before it plans, refuses a candidate with blocking diagnostics and re-reads the document immediately before the atomic write, so no change is lost and a refused run writes nothing. The re-read refusal (<<REF_IDX-CATALOG_REQUIREMENTS_CHANGE,requirements change>>d while delta was being planned) has no test: the lock already excludes every other run of this tool, so only an editor changing the file between planning and the write can reach it, and a test needs a seam in the code that was not added. It is defence in depth that the machine models and the verification debt of this <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> records. <<REF_IDX-MACHINE_SM_REQUIREMENTS_DELTA,SM-REQUIREMENTS-DELTA>> models these guards and its invariants (written implies a <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_VALID,valid>> candidate and an unchanged source) fail when a guard is removed.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_186]]
==== REQ-EMG-186

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_RELEASE_CHECK_REQUESTED,release check is requested>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall reject a release whose changelog entry declares a breaking release and whose <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> schema version is not greater than the schema version at the previous release.


NOTE: ADR-EMG-077. engws release-check reads the CHANGELOG section of the tag, and when it contains the words Breaking release it loads the manifest at the previous tag and reports release.schema_version_not_bumped (error, untiered) unless the schemaVersion of the head manifest is greater. A <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> whose schemaVersion is older than the engine supports is <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>>.unsupported_schema_version with the remedy, so a <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> written for an earlier release fails on its version first. Reading the previous tag is the only place an older schema version is accepted: the copy read for the contract diff is stamped with the current version in a temporary directory.

[[REF_REQ_REQ_EMG_187]]
==== REQ-EMG-187

When <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_EVT_MODEL_UPDATED,model updated event is received>>, the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SYS_ENGINEERING_MODEL_GO,engineering model go>> shall provide <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> links as the only way to trace a <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> to a <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> of another <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>>.


NOTE: ADR-EMG-078, removal plan phase 4. <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_COMPOSITION,composition>>.allocations and the delegation built on them, and engws migrate-links, are removed. A <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>> that carries <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_COMPOSITION,composition>>.allocations is the untiered error <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_MODEL,model>>.allocations_removed with the remedy to write <<REF_IDX-ENGMODEL_TERM_REQUIREMENT,requirement>> links (reqLinks) instead. The trace summary keeps the delegated count that links produce; hardware <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_ALLOCATION,allocation>> relationships of the <<REF_IDX-CATALOG_SEMANTIC_MODEL,semantic model>> are not touched.

== Contract Items

The capabilities and assumptions of use this model publishes, each with the requirements that realize it. A using system pins the version it reviewed in its requirement links; a release that changes the text or verification criteria of an item or a realizing requirement needs a new review in every user.

=== CAP-EMG-AIRBORNE-ASSURANCE (capability)

Check an aviation assurance profile for evidence readiness and generate clearly marked draft lifecycle data, trace and gap reports without claiming compliance, and keep AI agents from holding assurance credit. Owner FU-AIRBORNE-ASSURANCE-EXPORTER.

Realized by:

* `REQ-EMG-053`: Where do-178c dal c readiness output is enabled, when model updated event is received, the engineering model go shall load a strict aviation assurance profile plus lifecycle data plus verification evidence plus configuration baselines plus tool assessments plus structural coverage summaries.
* `REQ-EMG-054`: Where do-178c dal c readiness output is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall reject incomplete or inconsistent requirement classification plus derived requirement disposition plus verification chain plus independence plus baseline plus structural coverage plus tool assessment evidence.
* `REQ-EMG-055`: Where do-178c dal c readiness output is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall generate deterministic draft lifecycle data index plus objective evidence matrix plus requirements trace matrix plus verification summary plus structural coverage summary plus tool assessment register plus configuration index plus open gap report plus software accomplishment summary.
* `REQ-EMG-056`: When example validation is requested, the engineering model go shall validate a schema version 2 DAL C flight control software example with placeholder planning plus requirements plus design plus code plus verification plus coverage plus configuration plus quality assurance plus certification liaison evidence.
* `REQ-EMG-132`: When model updated event is received, the engineering model go shall report each aviation evidence record below the evidence floor of the life-cycle tier.
* `REQ-EMG-133`: When model updated event is received, the engineering model go shall report each aviation assurance record that names an AI agent as the person holding the credit.

=== CAP-EMG-ARCHITECTURE-INTERCHANGE (capability)

Export the model to architecture and threat tools - SysML v2 textual and project interchange, Structurizr DSL, Threat Dragon and Open Threat Model - with schema and metamodel conformance checks. Owner FU-SYSML-EXPORTER.

Realized by:

* `REQ-EMG-004`: Where threat export is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall export threat dragon json artifact plus open threat model artifact.
* `REQ-EMG-005`: Where structurizr export is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall export structurizr dsl artifact.
* `REQ-EMG-011`: Where external schema dependencies are available, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall fail validation if schema checks do not match expected constraints.
* `REQ-EMG-036`: Where sysml export is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall generate sysml v2 model artifact from canonical semantic model.
* `REQ-EMG-037`: While ci validation mode is active, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall validate sysml v2 model artifact before artifact generated event is raised.
* `REQ-EMG-038`: Where sysml export is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall validate canonical semantic model against sysml v2 metamodel.
* `REQ-EMG-039`: While ci validation mode is active, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall reject incomplete sysml v2 metamodel coverage.
* `REQ-EMG-040`: When generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall preserve the deterministic native sysml v2 source through project interchange round trip.

=== CAP-EMG-CODE-HEALTH (capability)

Score source files and functions for maintainability with an explainable model, roll the scores up to functional units and requirements, and check new or worsened findings against a base revision under a tier-keyed policy. Owner FU-CODE-HEALTH.

Realized by:

* `REQ-EMG-150`: When generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall report code health smells for each function of Go, Rust, TypeScript, JavaScript and Python source files.
* `REQ-EMG-151`: When generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall compute an explainable code health score from 1.0 to 10.0 for each source file.
* `REQ-EMG-152`: When generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall roll up file code health scores along the traceability of the model.
* `REQ-EMG-153`: When model updated event is received, the engineering model go shall validate the manifest health block including exclude, thresholds, overrides and waivers.
* `REQ-EMG-154`: When model updated event is received, the engineering model go shall require each code health waiver to cite an existing accepted decision.
* `REQ-EMG-155`: When model updated event is received, the engineering model go shall report code health findings in enghealth reports with the severity of the project life-cycle tier.
* `REQ-EMG-156`: When generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall classify each code health finding against a base revision of the working tree.
* `REQ-EMG-157`: When generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall write the code health report in the neutral format engmod-health/1.
* `REQ-EMG-158`: When generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall run code health analysis with enghealth scan, check and baseline, exiting 0 when ok, 1 on blocking findings and 2 on a setup error.
* `REQ-EMG-160`: When model updated event is received, the engineering model go shall produce byte-identical validation diagnostics and generated documents for a model without a health block at the tiers below product.
* `REQ-EMG-161`: When generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall treat a finding listed in the committed health baseline as accepted debt.

=== CAP-EMG-COMPLIANCE-EXPORT (capability)

Export traceability and assurance records to compliance tooling - TRLC, LOBSTER, OSCAL and OpenSSF Gemara - from the modeled requirements, controls and risks. Owner FU-OSCAL-EXPORTER.

Realized by:

* `REQ-EMG-006`: Where traceability export is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall produce trlc package and lobster trace report artifacts.
* `REQ-EMG-013`: Where traceability export is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall export an OSCAL aggregate profile plus SSP plus assessment plan plus assessment results plus POA&M artifacts when the corresponding compliance and remediation content is applicable.
* `REQ-EMG-015`: Where gemara export is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall render OpenSSF Gemara model artifacts.
* `REQ-EMG-062`: Where gemara export is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall derive each gemara enforcement disposition plus policy risk treatment from the model status.

=== CAP-EMG-FORMAL-BEHAVIOR (capability)

Model behavior as state machines with guarded transitions and invariants linked to requirements, validate them, generate one Quint module per machine, and record fresh pass or fail results as formal evidence. Owner FU-QUINT-EXPORTER.

Realized by:

* `REQ-EMG-135`: When model updated event is received, the engineering model go shall load each machine authored in a behavior document with its variables, states, initial state, final states, transitions and invariants.
* `REQ-EMG-138`: When model updated event is received, the engineering model go shall validate each machine against the machine rules.
* `REQ-EMG-139`: When model updated event is received, the engineering model go shall reject free-floating behavior states with a diagnostic that names the machines block.
* `REQ-EMG-140`: When model updated event is received, the engineering model go shall report each advisory machine diagnostic with the severity of the project life-cycle tier.
* `REQ-EMG-141`: When generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall generate one deterministic Quint module for each machine.
* `REQ-EMG-142`: When generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall generate Quint modules with engquint generate and check them with engquint check, exiting 0 on pass, 1 on a violation, a stale or drifted module or a vacuous trace and 2 on a setup error.
* `REQ-EMG-143`: When generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall run Quint on the TypeScript backend once for each invariant.
* `REQ-EMG-144`: When generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall verify each machine in verify mode against a pre-provisioned pinned Apalache without a download at run time.
